subject: Medford Teachers Association Contract Ratification
overview: The School Committee ratified a new contract for the district's teachers and reviewed reports regarding the start of the 2018-2019 school year. The committee also addressed a significant funding gap for the Roberts Elementary Playground project, hearing testimony on alternative procurement methods.

items.title: Discussion of Warrants
items.summary: Committee members requested clarification on scholarship payments, conference dues for transitioning administrators, and the accounting for vocational revolving funds.

items.title: Ratification of Medford Teachers Association Contract
items.summary: The committee voted to approve the memorandum of agreement and ratify the new contract with the Medford Teachers Association.

items.title: Report on Opening of Schools
items.summary: The Superintendent introduced several new building principals and administrators while reporting a successful start to the academic year.

items.title: Report on Buildings and Grounds
items.summary: The Buildings and Grounds department detailed summer maintenance including flooring replacement at multiple schools, roof repairs at the McGlynn, and playground surfacing work.

items.title: Roberts Elementary Playground Renovation Project
items.summary: Following reports that project bids significantly exceeded the original grant amount, the committee heard parent testimony suggesting the use of statewide contracts to reduce costs. The committee approved a motion for city procurement and legal staff to meet with parent advocates to evaluate these alternative procurement options.

items.title: Community Participation
items.summary: Residents inquired about maintenance plans for the new turf field at the Brooks School and expressed concerns regarding excessive heat and a lack of air conditioning in high school classrooms.

items.title: Band Room Dedication Proposal
items.summary: A proposal to dedicate the high school band room to former committee member Lena Gigentomaso was referred to the Committee of the Whole for review according to district naming policies.

items.title: Reports on Administrative Meetings and Enrollment
items.summary: District officials reviewed summer professional development for staff and provided current enrollment data, noting a need for closer monitoring of class sizes at the Roberts School.

items.title: Reports on Summer Programs and Teacher Induction
items.summary: Staff highlighted the success of various summer initiatives, including a STEM enrichment program for English Learners and a four-day orientation for new teachers.

items.title: Routine Reports and Personnel Actions
items.summary: The committee accepted reports on transportation, the hiring of a new Human Resources coordinator, a $500 scholarship in memory of Sarah Palumbo, and a $10,000 donation from Impact Church.

items.title: Discussion on School Supplies and Vocational Vacancies
items.summary: The committee discussed ideas for a district-run school supply store to save parents money and reviewed the critical vacancy in the vocational HVAC program caused by industry wage competition.
